title: Akiyama Mizuki — What Gave Me Courage〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: And Now, I Wear This Ribbon

rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
I slept really well...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's noon already?
Haha. I must've been more tired than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be fair, I worked on the finishing touches for our music video until around dawn...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Mizuki, are you awake?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line:
Good morning, Mizuki.
I made lunch if you'd like some.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line: Also, I won't be home until late tonight, so you and your father will need to heat something up for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay. Thanks, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line:
Anytime.
Oh, I'm going to send your sister some things. Would you like to include anything?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She sent me a bunch of cute clothes, so I kinda want to thank her for that somehow.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line:
Of course.
I'm thinking about sending that package out next weekend, so if you can think of something by then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Next weekend...?
Yeah, sure thing!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, I'll be off.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Have fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... What should I send...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mom always makes sure to get Sis her favorite fashion magazines...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, if I'm gonna send her something, I wanna send her something that'll put a smile on her face.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What did she say when we talked on the phone yesterday?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We chatted about that ribbon she sent me, I thanked her for sending me those snacks and...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh...?
How have I been lately?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's sort of the reason why I ultimately decided to join N25.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That reminds me. I mentioned that I was still in a group, but not much else.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nothing about meeting everyone in real life, going on day trips with them or that picnic...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: It's perfectly okay for you to do what you want, Mizuki, because I'm absolutely sure that you'll find others who understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I mean, you're just the cutest!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: So, you should go where you want to go... And be where you want to be.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Where I want to be, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can start by choosing the best pics from our mystery tour...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Let's see... Where did I save them...?
Aha, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I should include the ones showing the cherry blossom tree by that abandoned school. Also, some pics of when I went on that picnic with Shizuku and the others♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sis never seemed all that interested in idols, but she's gotta know who Shizuku and Airi are! She's not gonna believe this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I can't forget the Sports Festival!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I wanna see the look on her face when she sees that I participated in a school event and even joined the cheer squad.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Or... Is she gonna feel really worried and wonder if I'm doing too much...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... It's definitely a possibility, so I should choose pictures that show me smiling and having fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, let's review my current selection...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Look at me... Smiling and having so much fun.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (During the Sports Festival, and when we went to PXL...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: These should put Sis's fears to rest.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Because I really am having fun.
Because you encouraged me to do so, Sis.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm a little shy about doing this, but I wanna write her a letter...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I didn't get a chance to tell her on the phone yesterday...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I really need to thank her.)
